text:
아 돈 아깝다...
한국인 호갱인건가
내가 호갱인건가ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
생각없이 갔다가 대 실망

리뷰이벤트 안 하는 사람이랑 차이가 심한가
어디 코딱지만한 망고 종잇장 처럼 썰어서 주고
심지어 맛도 없는걸ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
20만동이나 받아먹는 그런곳!!!
내 발로 간거라 할 수 없지만
진짜 돈이 아까워서
뭣도 없는데 글써요..ㅋㅋㅋ
개 열씨미 쓰네ㅋㅋㅋ아 현타온다

이런곳들 자꾸팔아주니
한국인 호구로알고
비싸게 받는 곳이 점점 느는듯
내돈쓰러 오는거지만 호구는 노노
다른 집 망빙도 맛은 똑같이 개떡이어도
망고는 그래도 넉넉하게 주던데
내가 재수가없는건지.....ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
사진이라 커보이지만 개작음..
textTranslated:
Ah, what a waste of money...

Are Koreans suckers?

Am I the sucker? Hahaha.

I went without thinking and was totally disappointed.

Is there a huge difference between people who don't participate in review events and those who do?

They sliced ​​a tiny piece of mango like a sheet of paper and gave it to me.

And it didn't even taste good. Hahaha.

A place that charges 200,000 VND for it!!!

I went there on my own accord so I can't really complain, but

I really wasted my money, so

I'm writing this even though there's nothing to it... Hahaha.

I'm writing this really hard, haha. Ah, I'm having a reality check.

Since people keep buying from places like this,

they think Koreans are suckers,

and the number of places charging high prices seems to be increasing.

I'm here to spend my own money, but I'm not a sucker.

Even at other places, the mango shaved ice tastes just as awful,

but at least they give you a generous amount of mango.

Maybe I'm just unlucky... Hahaha.

It looks big in the picture, but it's tiny...

맛: 뜨거운 아메리카노 시켰는데, 온도가 정수물느낌? 원샷이 가능할정도의 온도네요..뜨거운물이랑 섞어먹으려고 내려가서 커피가 뜨겁지않다고 뜨거운 물 한잔달랬는데 귀찮은듯 커피보트 물이 끓기도 전에 주네요. 물을 그자리에서 받자마자 바로마셨는데 미지근..휴..다시 핫 워터로 체인지 해달라하니 핫 워터도 못알아듣네요..다시 설명해서 뜨거운 물 한잔받아와서 섞어 마셨네요..근데 카드결제가 왜안되는지도 이해가 안되긴 합니다.

서비스: 작년에는 카운터에  한국인사장님이 있어서 그랬던건건지, 오늘은 직원들이 서비스가 장착이 안된느낌이네요..  응대가 너무부족하고, 해결해주려는 느낌보다는 귀찮은듯 하는 느낌이라..다시는 오지않을거같아요.

분위기:작년에 2층에 포토존 느낌으로 사진찍기도 좋은 카페느낌이었는데.. 올해는 공간가득 테이블만 꽉 차있는 느낌이라 분위기 좋은 느낌은 없네요.. 그리고 지금시즌이 크리스마스시즌이라 어딜가더라도 간단한 크리스마스장식이랑, 캐롤이 있는데, 여기 2층은 창문하나없는 갇힌듯한 느낌의 답답한 느낌입니다.음악도 없으니 더 그런거같기도하네요..

총평: 혹시 카페그린 사장님이 이글을본다면 직원들교육과 전반적인 분위기에 대해 고민해보시기를 바랍니다.
textTranslated:
I visited about three times during my trip to Da Nang last year.

I came back this year because I wanted to eat mango shaved ice on a rainy day while visiting Da Nang... but I am leaving disappointed in all three aspects: service, taste, and atmosphere.

Taste: I ordered a hot Americano, but the temperature felt like filtered water? It was cold enough to chug down in one go. I went down to mix it with hot water, but when I asked for a cup of hot water because the coffee wasn't hot enough, they gave it to me before the water in the coffee pot even boiled, acting as if they were annoyed. I drank the water immediately after receiving it, but it was lukewarm. Sigh. I asked them to change it to hot water, but they didn't even understand what I meant. I had to explain it again to get a cup of hot water to mix it. However, I also don't understand why they don't accept card payments.

Service: Maybe it was because the Korean owner was at the counter last year, but today the staff seemed to lack service skills. Their response was very inadequate; instead of feeling like they were trying to resolve my issues, they seemed annoyed. I don't think I will ever come back.

Service: I visited about three times during my trip to Da Nang last year. Atmosphere: Last year, the second floor felt like a photo zone, creating a cafe atmosphere perfect for taking pictures. However, this year, the space feels cramped with nothing but tables, so the atmosphere isn't very pleasant. Also, since it is the Christmas season, you usually see simple decorations and carols everywhere you go, but the second floor here feels stifling and enclosed, with not a single window. The lack of music might make it feel even worse.

Overall Review: If the owner of Cafe Green happens to see this post, I hope they will consider staff training and the overall atmosphere.

더운 날씨에 지칠때 달콤한 망고빙수 최고에요...❤️ 점원분들도 친절하고, 에어컨도 빵빵해서 시원하고 ! 화장실도 남녀분리(중요)라서 이용하기 편합니당
2층까지 있어서 와서 앉아있기 좋고 공간이 좁지않아 캐리어나 짐이 있어도 보관하기 딱이에여 🥹 일단 망고가 너무 푸짐하게 올라가있어서 좋구 절반정도 먹다가 같이 주는 연유 뿌려먹으면 그냥 뚝딱임니다...
깨끗하고 시원한 망빙집 찾으시면은 여기강추해요 다음에도 또 올것임,,, ❤️❤️❤️❤️
textTranslated:
Sweet mango bingsu is the best when you're exhausted from the hot weather...❤️ The staff are friendly, and the air conditioning is blasting so it's nice and cool! The restrooms are also separate for men and women (important), so it's convenient to use.

It has two floors, so it's a great place to sit, and since the space isn't cramped, it's perfect for storing suitcases or luggage 🥹 First off, I love that there is such a generous amount of mango on top, and once you've eaten about half of it and drizzle the condensed milk they provide, it's gone in a flash...

If you're looking for a clean and refreshing mango bingsu place, I highly recommend this place. I will definitely be back next time... ❤️❤️❤️❤️
address: 54 Nguyễn Thái Học, Hải Châu, Đà Nẵng 550000, Vietnam

I will absolutely never go there again...

textTranslated:
Mango ice cream 200,000KRW (about 10,000 won)
On top was a slightly unripe mango, and inside was diced frozen mango. It was so cold outside that I thought it was Sulbing. Other reviews didn't say much, but ours came with the top completely melted... Ugh... The whipped cream tasted better than the ice cream.
The top was good, but the bottom was a bit greasy, so -2 points.

If you're coming from far away, try the cafe next to Lotte Mart for mango ice cream.

text:
어제 이곳에 손님으로 방문했다가 정말 불쾌한 경험을 했습니다. 예전에 이곳에서 오랫동안 근무했었고, 당시 사장님도 정말 좋으신 분이었습니다. 그런데 오늘 다시 찾아왔을 때는 전혀 다른 분위기였습니다.

저와 함께 온 일행이 많아서, 가게가 바쁜 상황을 고려해 몇 잔의 음료를 직접 만들어 도우려고 했습니다. 예전에 함께 일했던 과장님도 저를 반갑게 웃으며 맞아 주셨습니다. 그런데 새로 온 한국인 매니저님께 인사를 드리며 제 소개를 했더니, 그분은 저를 단호하게 가게 밖으로 내보냈습니다.

저는 오늘 이곳을 손님으로 방문했고, 친구들에게 이곳을 소개하며 가게를 응원하는 마음으로 왔습니다. 그런데 마치 아무런 가치도 없는 사람처럼 무시당한 느낌을 받았습니다. 손님으로서도, 예전에 이곳에 기여했던 직원으로서도 전혀 존중받지 못했습니다.

새 매니저님은 직원과 손님에 대한 태도를 다시 한번 되돌아보셨으면 합니다.!!!
textTranslated:
I had a truly unpleasant experience visiting this place as a customer yesterday. I used to work here for a long time, and the owner at the time was a really nice person. However, when I returned today, the atmosphere was completely different.

Since I was with a large group and the shop was busy, I tried to help by making a few drinks myself. The manager I used to work with also welcomed me with a warm smile. However, when I greeted the new Korean manager and introduced myself, he firmly kicked me out of the shop.

I visited today as a customer, intending to support the shop and introduce it to my friends. Yet, I felt completely ignored, as if I were worthless. I was not respected at all, neither as a customer nor as an employee who had contributed to this place in the past.

I hope the new manager reflects once again on their attitude toward both staff and customers!!!

text:
아정말 화납니다. 두번 방문했으나 한번도 못먹음. 심지어 자리없다그래서 기다렸다가 앉았는데 주문하려고 하니 5시부터 시작할수 있다고 함(앉은 시간 4시 27분)
1. 기다리는 손님들 사전안내 없음.
2. 나가서 기다리라고 하고 나가서 기다리는데 새로운 손님들 또 막 들어가면 그냥 그사람들이 자리 앉아버림
3. 내 알빠 아니고 너네가 알아서 앉아라. 근데 나가서 기다리라고 함
4. 내 앞손님 앉았는데 주문 받고 우리부터는 재료소진으로 주문 안된다고 함. 그롬 기다리라고 하질 말던지 말을 해주던지 기다린시간만 버림

무튼 개매너에 손님 항시꽉차서 그런지 사전 안내없고 자리안내없고 개판오분전으로 관리 1도 안됨. 콩카페나 식당도 직원들이 자리안내 해주고 번호표 주고 하는데 그런 시스템없음 미쳐돌아버림 막어보지도 못했지만 다신안감. 가격도 무지비쌈
textTranslated:
I am so angry. I visited twice but couldn't get a table even once. I waited because they said there were no seats available, but when I tried to order, they told me they could only start serving at 5 PM (I sat down at 4:27 PM).

1. No prior notice was given to the waiting customers.

2. They told us to go outside and wait, but when new customers kept coming in, they just sat down.

3. It’s none of my business; you guys sit wherever you want. But they still told us to go outside and wait.

4. The customer in front of me sat down, took their order, and then said they couldn't take orders from us onwards because they had run out of ingredients. Then they shouldn't have told us to wait, or at least told us. I just wasted my time waiting.

Anyway, they have terrible manners. Maybe because it’s always packed, there is no prior notice or seating guidance; it’s a total mess with absolutely no management. Even Cong Cafe or restaurants have staff guide you to seats and give you number tickets, but they don't have that kind of system here. It’s driving me crazy. I couldn't even stop them, but I’m never going back. The prices are also ridiculously high.
address: 54 Nguyễn Thái Học, Hải Châu, Đà Nẵng 550000, Vietnam

text:
그냥 솔직 담백 리뷰 남깁니다. 처음 방문한게 작년 4월쯤인데 그땐 망고빙수가 너무 맛있었고 가격도 괜찮았습니다. 물론 웨이팅도 없었고 가게가 너무 예쁘다고 생각했습니다. 근데 1년후인 지금 입구부터 웨이팅이 있길래 놀랬습니다. 가격도 빙수는 20만동...망고를 주는 양은 처음과 비슷한데 망고 맛이 이전처럼 존맛이 아니었습니다. 예전엔 깟화롯 망고를 쓰나 하는 생각이 들 정도로 맛있었는데 지금은 망고가 좀 덜 익은거처럼 딱딱한 느낌이 조금 있었습니다. 말랑하지만 조금은 딱딱한...여튼 들어와서 주문을 해도 메뉴가 나오는데 20분정도를 더 기다려야했습니다. 물론 이런 상황까지 다 판단하고 기다려서 먹었는데 1년전 처음의 맛을 잊지 못한건지 이곳이 변한건지 예전만하지 못하다는 판단이 들었습니다. 물론 이정도 맛이면 베트남에 와서 먹는 망고빙수로 나쁘진 않습니다. 다낭에 와서 망고를 빙수와 시원하게 조지겠다 하신다면 오셔도 괜찮을듯 합니다. 다만 맛있는거만 먹겠다고 하면 사람 몰리는 시간을 피하고, 망고가 잘 익었길 기대하며 오시는게 좋을듯 합니다.
p.s. 망고 스무디에서 파인애플맛이 조금 나는데 그건 왜 그런지 모르겠습니다. 사장님께서 추가로 맛을 가미하기 위해 넣었는가? 하는 생각을 했습니다.
textTranslated:
I'll just leave an honest and candid review. I first visited here around April of last year, and the mango bingsu was delicious and reasonably priced. There was no wait, and I thought the shop was incredibly pretty. But now, a year later, I was surprised to see a line right outside the entrance. The price was 200,000 VND for the bingsu... The amount of mango they serve is similar to the first time, but the mango flavor wasn't as good as before. It used to be so delicious I wondered if they used Cat Hwa Lot mangoes, but now the mangoes felt a bit hard, like they weren't ripe. They were soft, but a little hard... Anyway, even after ordering, I had to wait another 20 minutes for my food to come out. Of course, I considered all this before I waited, but I don't know if they still remember the taste from a year ago, or if the place has changed, but it's not as good as it used to be. Of course, for a mango bingsu in Vietnam, this isn't bad. If you're looking for a refreshing mango bingsu in Da Nang, this is a great option. However, if you're only going to eat delicious food, it's best to avoid the crowds and come hoping the mangoes are ripe. 
P.S. The mango smoothie has a hint of pineapple flavor, but I don't know why. I wonder if the owner added it for extra flavor.

textTranslated:
After visiting Han Market, I stopped by to have an Americano and a Banh Mi based on a friend's recommendation.

The atmosphere of the shop was nice.

However, since they didn't have a coffee machine, they served me Vietnamese coffee with ice instead of an Americano.

I would like to request that Americano be removed from the menu.

Also, please remove the raisins from the nuts in the Coconut & Chocolate drink. They were so hard that I thought my teeth were going to break.

I am not trying to be critical. Since the owner is Korean, I am writing this simply hoping they would pay just a little more attention to detail.

text:
에어컨이 정말 시원하다.

그것만으로도 다낭에서는 정말 굿굿

맛은 응 나쁘지 않고 우유빙수가 슴슴하니 좋다.

망고는  이쁘게 데고되서 나와서 좋은데 위에 있는 아이스크림과 시럽은 없는게 더 맛있을 정도 !!!!

높은가격에 비해 망고의 양이 적어서 조금 실망
내가 먹은 망고는 달달했지만 시럽에 절여진 느낌이라 망고철이 아니면 망고의 질에 아쉬울듯

한국인사장님이라  현금만 받고 카드결제가 안돼는데 베트남의 나쁜 룰 같다. 높은가격에도 현금만 받는 한국인 전용가게가 많음 !

코코넛 스무디도 나쁘지 않어서 먹어보는걸도 추천하고 여기 있음 100프로 한국인으로 가득 차는 가게를 볼수가있다.

현지인 0.  외국인 0. 한국인 100

한국인 인스타 집 !

한시장  들렀다가 콩카페에 한국인이 너무 많다면 여기와서 쉬다가는건 추천. !
textTranslated:
The air conditioning is really cool.

That alone makes it a great place to visit in Da Nang.

The taste isn't bad, and the milk shaved ice is refreshingly smooth.

The mango is beautifully simmered, which is nice, but the ice cream and syrup on top are even better without it!

The small amount of mango is a bit disappointing considering the high price. The mango I had was sweet, but it felt like it was soaked in syrup, so if it's not mango season, the quality might be a bit lacking.

The owner is Korean, so they only accept cash and no cards, which seems like a bad rule in Vietnam. There are many Korean-only shops that accept cash, even at high prices!

The coconut smoothie is also pretty good, so I recommend trying it. You'll see the shop filled with 100% Koreans here.

0 locals, 0 foreigners, 100 Koreans

Korean Instagram!

If you stop by Han Market and find Cong Cafe overflowing with Koreans, I recommend stopping by here for a break!

textTranslated:
The overall atmosphere was fine.
It was a bit disappointing that it was so crowded and chaotic.

The person taking our order was a bit awkward, but she did her best to speak Korean, which was nice and thankful.

The mango was a bit too long to eat, so it was a bit difficult to eat.

It was cut so long that it ended up spilling all over the sides when I put it in my mouth.

And the most disappointing part was that the spoon was a flimsy, disposable wooden spoon.

The thin wooden spoon that came with the Double Bianco...

That was the most disappointing part.

If they switched to a metal spoon, the mango bingsu would taste even better.

I wonder why no one mentions it.

Other than that, the coffee was delicious, and I thoroughly enjoyed it!
I think the owner is Korean :)
I hope you prosper ♡♡♡

On the fourth and final day of our trip, we left our luggage at the hotel and returned to Han Market, where we had been on the first day. Shopping at Han Market with kids is pure hell, so today we came into a cafe with the Galpad, and Dad and Mom plan to take turns shopping separately.

The seating is comfortable, and the space is pleasant, which is great.

As soon as we entered, a Korean owner welcomed us, giving us the feeling that we were actually in Da Nang, Gyeonggi-do, haha.

The Korean music playing was also so heartwarming, haha.

We ordered a coconut coffee smoothie and a coconut ice cream coconut smoothie, and the kids really enjoyed them.

Since my daughters don't like mango... they couldn't eat the mango shaved ice.

The Wi-Fi is strong, and it's a great place to take a short break.

I highly recommend stopping by if you plan to shop at Han Market! 👍 👍 👍 👍 👍

text:

However, had a little complaint about the service….

From the moment I walked in the door, “Anehaseyo!”  Wait, am I in Seoul?? No, I’m in Da Nang, Vietnam~

I guess the owner of this shop is Korean and/or they cater to 99% Korean customers. If you are a light-skinned Asian, they assume you are Korean (I am not).

Even when I ordered in English, the Vietnamese staff spoke Korean to me.

So, in conclusion, it’s a delicious Korean-style fruits dessert shop 😂

그냥 다른 말 필요 없이 여기가 최고이고 천국임.

이 가격 그대로 한국 가져가고 싶을정도입니다.

망고빙수는 그냥먹다가 연유를 추가하는걸 추천.
코코넛빙수는 먹고 코코넛껍질에 붙어있는 흰과육 숟가락으로 퍼먹으면 또 다른 신기한맛 추가!
textTranslated:
Simply put, no other words are needed; this place is the best and heaven.

The mango shaved ice was so delicious that I felt it would be a shame to only have one, so I tried the coconut shaved ice as well, and I was simply amazed.

The air conditioning is on full blast, and it’s so pleasant and comfortable.

Putting the review event aside, this place is genuinely amazing.

I feel like I want to take this place back to Korea at this exact price.

For the mango shaved ice, I recommend eating it plain first and then adding condensed milk.

For the coconut shaved ice, if you scoop up the white flesh attached to the coconut shell with a spoon, you get a whole new, fascinating flavor!

textTranslated:
We took a Grab to the Pink Cathedral and only took a few photos, but it was so hot that we were planning to go to a famous cafe nearby. However, the reviews were bad, saying they were unfriendly to Koreans. So, we were looking around for somewhere else nearby when my husband spotted this place, so we came in.

The air conditioning is blasting, and it's very clean.

The shaved ice is milk-based, like snow cones, so it's delicious and smooth. My child really enjoyed it.

The ice cream is great too.

The owner is Korean, so you can transfer money in Korean, and all the staff speak Korean well. We had a cool and comfortable stay without any inconveniences.
